name: ERQA
intro: ERQA（Embodied Reasoning Question Answering）是 Google DeepMind 随 Gemini Robotics 发布的开放具身推理基准。它包含 400 道图文交错的四选一 VQA，覆盖空间、轨迹、动作、状态估计、指向、多视角和任务推理；其中 28% 使用多张图像。
build_method: 具身能力分类, 团队策展图文交错选择题, 问题类型标注, TFRecord公开发布
eval_feature: 八类具身推理, 28%多图题, 直接与思维链提示, 分类别准确率
scale: 400个问题（84空间、72动作、66轨迹、55状态、38任务、37多视角、34指向、14其他）
build_method_en: Embodied-capability taxonomy, team-curated interleaved VQA, question-type labels, public TFRecord release
eval_feature_en: Eight embodied-reasoning categories, 28% multi-image, direct/CoT prompting, category accuracy
intro_en: ERQA (Embodied Reasoning Question Answering) is an open embodied-reasoning benchmark released by Google DeepMind with Gemini Robotics. It contains 400 interleaved image-text four-choice VQA items spanning spatial, trajectory, action, state-estimation, pointing, multi-view, and task reasoning; 28% use multiple images.
scale_en: 400 questions (84 spatial, 72 action, 66 trajectory, 55 state, 38 task, 37 multi-view, 34 pointing, 14 other)
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Define physical-world embodied reasoning capabilities beyond atomic perception"] --> B["Curate interleaved one-or-more-image, text, four-choice VQA items"]
    B --> C["Assign eight question types across 400 questions; preserve 28% multi-image items"]
    C --> D["Release TFRecord fields: question, images, answer, question type, visual indices"]
    D --> E["Run zero-shot direct or exact optional CoT prompting"]
    E --> F["Parse final A/B/C/D option and compare with ground truth"]
    F --> G["Report overall and per-category accuracy"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["定义超越原子感知的物理世界具身推理能力"] --> B["策展一张或多张图像与文本交错的四选一VQA"]
    B --> C["为400题标注八类问题，并保留28%多图题"]
    C --> D["以TFRecord发布问题、图像、答案、类型与视觉索引字段"]
    D --> E["进行零样本直接提示或论文原始可选思维链提示"]
    E --> F["解析最终A/B/C/D选项并与标准答案比对"]
    F --> G["报告总体与分类别准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Gemini Robotics report arXiv:2503.20020 Section 2.1, Figures 3–5, Tables 1–2, and the official embodiedreasoning/ERQA release. The diagram records the physical-world capability scope; interleaved one-or-more-image four-choice VQA format; all 400 questions; category counts from Figure 4 (84 spatial, 72 action, 66 trajectory, 55 state estimation, 38 task, 37 multi-view, 34 pointing, and 14 other); the 28% multi-image share; cross-frame registration, affordance, and 3D-relation demands; TFRecord fields question, image/encoded, answer, question_type, and visual_indices under CC BY 4.0; zero-shot direct and the report's optional CoT instruction; final-option parsing; and overall/category accuracy. The report and repository do not disclose an image-acquisition or question-authoring protocol, so the diagram explicitly avoids inventing one.
